faq.question: How long does a website take?
faq.answer: Timeline depends on the number of pages, features and revision requirements. We discuss and agree on a timeline before development begins.

faq.question: Do you provide domain and hosting?
faq.answer: Yes. If required, GenWebZy can help with domain and hosting setup as part of the project.

faq.question: Can you redesign an existing website?
faq.answer: Yes. Existing websites can be redesigned and modernized based on the requirement.

faq.question: Will my website work on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes. Websites are designed responsively to work on mobile, tablet and desktop devices.

faq.question: Can I request changes?
faq.answer: Yes. Revision limits and requirements are discussed before the project begins.

faq.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faq.answer: Yes. Maintenance and support can be discussed depending on the project.

faq.question: How does payment work?
faq.answer: Payment terms are clearly mentioned in the project quotation before development begins.

reviews.name: Arjun Sharma
reviews.text: Genwebzy delivered a polished, fast business website in under 2 weeks. The design is clean and our customers love how easy it is to navigate. Highly recommended for any local business.

reviews.name: Priya Nair
reviews.text: I needed a portfolio that reflected my design work and Genwebzy nailed it. The attention to detail was impressive — every section was exactly how I envisioned it.

reviews.name: Mohammed Farhan
reviews.text: We got a conversion-focused landing page for our product launch. The WhatsApp integration alone brought in 30+ enquiries in the first week. Excellent work and great communication throughout.
